fields.label: Bezeichnung
fields.description: Internal label for this Product Sync, e.g. 'Main shop: best sellers'.

fields.label: Aktiv (am Cron-Sync teilnehmen)
fields.description: When 0, the sync only runs when started manually.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: On conflicts (an item matches multiple active syncs), higher priority wins. Ties fall back to conflict_policy.

fields.label: Ziel-Storefronts
fields.description: Storefronts where this product should be visible. Multiple allowed — the product is shipped to every listed storefront.

fields.label: Item scope
fields.description: Bestimmt, welche ERPNext-Artikel von diesem Sync abgedeckt werden.

fields.label: Scope mode
fields.options:
Catalog Mirror
Item Group Subtree
Smart Collection
Custom Filter
All

fields.label: Linked collection (legacy)
fields.description: Legacy field — replaced by the 'Linked Collections' table. Content is migrated by the patch; this field remains for backwards compatibility.

fields.label: Linked collections
fields.description: One or more Smart Collections — every item in scope lands in the sync. Optional per-row storefront filter pins a collection to a single channel.

fields.label: Varianten als Children pushen
fields.description: Bei Shopware werden Varianten als verschachtelte Children unter dem Template-Produkt erzeugt.

fields.label: Minimum stock for push
fields.description: 0 = kein Filter; bei >0 werden Artikel mit weniger Bestand vom Push ausgeschlossen.

fields.label: Was synchronisiert wird
fields.description: Toggleable per field group. Useful e.g. to pause images on the first sync and catch them up later.

fields.label: Inhalt
fields.description: How name / description / price are produced in the backend.

fields.label: Name template
fields.description: Jinja template for the product name in the backend.

fields.label: Generate missing AI descriptions before sync
fields.description: Before each run, call generate_descriptions_batch() once for items without an AI description. Capped at max_ai_pre_generate (default 100) per run so a single sync can't exhaust the token budget.

fields.label: Max. AI-Generierungen pro Lauf
fields.description: Cap for AI generations per sync run. 0 = unlimited (caution: each generation costs Gemini tokens).

fields.label: SEO-Fallback (Jinja)
fields.description: Rendered when the corresponding Item field is empty. Variables: {{ item }}, {{ sync }}, {{ brand }} (channel branding if available). Example: '{{ item.item_name }} | {{ brand.brand_name or item.brand or "" }}' for the meta title.

fields.label: Meta title template
fields.description: Fallback for item.meta_title. Example: {{ item.item_name }} | {{ item.brand or '' }}

fields.label: Meta description template
fields.description: Fallback for item.meta_description. Render errors collapse to an empty string so a broken template can't stop the sync.

fields.label: Slug template
fields.description: Fallback for item.seo_slug / item.slug. Slugified automatically on render.

fields.label: Preis-Strategie
fields.description: channel_price_list = je Storefront eigene Price List; item_standard_rate = Standardverkaufspreis; custom_markup = Standardpreis ± Prozent.

fields.label: Globale Price List (Override)
fields.description: Wird genutzt, wenn die Storefront in target_sales_channels keine eigene override_price_list gesetzt hat.

fields.label: Aufschlag in %
fields.description: +10 = 10% Aufschlag, -5 = 5% Rabatt.

fields.label: Lebenszyklus
fields.description: How the sync handles items that no longer match or that conflict.

fields.label: Verwaiste Backend-Produkte
fields.description: What to do with backend products that no longer match the scope. keep = unchanged. deactivate = deactivate in the backend. delete = delete (dangerous). report = report only.

fields.label: Konflikt-Strategie
fields.description: When an item appears in multiple active syncs at the same priority.

fields.label: Auto-create Shopware rules
fields.description: For per-storefront pricing, Shopware pricing rules are auto-created and bound to the storefront.

fields.label: Bild-Sync
fields.description: How images are pushed to the backend.

fields.label: Transport
fields.description: url_with_bytes_fallback = prefer URL reference, only upload binaries when the URL is recognised as internal. url_only = always URL. bytes_only = always binary.

fields.label: Interne Host-Muster
fields.description: One pattern per line, e.g. *.internal, 192.168.*, erp.local. On match, the image is uploaded as a binary.

fields.label: Schedule
fields.description: When the sync runs automatically.

fields.label: Cron preset
fields.description: manual = nur per Knopf. Andere Werte starten den Sync zyklisch.

fields.label: Eigener Cron-Ausdruck
fields.description: Cron-Ausdruck im 5-Felder-Format, z.B. 0 3 * * *

fields.label: Manuelle Overrides
fields.description: Special cases per item: manually link an existing backend product, skip an item, or override individual fields.

fields.label: Standard-Sandbox-Channel
fields.description: Sales-channel UUID pre-selected by the sandbox-push dialog. Must have is_sandbox=1 in the sales-channel settings, otherwise it's ignored.
